page: Amazon Web Services g7e.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated computing instance powered by the AWS Nitro System, built for memory-heavy graphics, visualization, and artificial intelligence workloads. The instance integrates 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8559C processor clocked at 2.4 GHz with 320 MB of L3 cache. It supports advanced vector extensions including AVX-512 and AMX matrix instructions. System memory comprises 256 GB of DDR5 operating at 6 GHz, supplying 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU equipped with 96 GB of VRAM. Dedicated local storage includes a 1900 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 100 Gbps baseline network interface.

Benchmark results demonstrate top-decile performance in large language model inference across multiple model tiers. For 7B parameter models, the instance achieves 7244.99 prompt tokens per second and 221.14 generation tokens per second. In 70B parameter model execution, it delivers 1314.55 prompt tokens per second and 31.02 generation tokens per second. Geekbench scores highlight top-tier single-core execution at 2278.0 alongside top-tier image processing throughput. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 198.11 GB/sec in the top 25% percentile. In contrast, multi-core stress-ng tests and compilation benchmarks score in the middle 50% band, reflecting an architecture prioritized for vector and GPU offloading rather than raw multi-core CPU scaling.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, coupled with 96 GB of GPU memory, enables large parameter sets and dataset caches to stay resident in active memory. While CPU-only throughput remains average for 32 vCPUs, the combination of dense DDR5 memory, bundled 1.9 TB NVMe local storage, and 100 Gbps networking provides high efficiency for data-intensive pipelines. The instance is suitable for large language model serving, computer vision processing, generative image pipelines, 3D rendering, and data science workloads requiring extensive GPU VRAM and fast network throughput.
description: Amazon Web Services g7e.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance engineered for memory-heavy AI inference, computer vision, and graphics workflows. Built on the AWS Nitro System, the instance features an Intel Xeon 8559C x86_64 processor delivering 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores at 2.4 GHz, complemented by 256 GB of 6 GHz DDR5 memory and 320 MB of L3 cache. Graphics and tensor processing are powered by a bundled NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU featuring 96 GB of VRAM. High-speed local IO is supported through a 1900 GB NVMe SSD alongside a 100 Gbps network bandwidth baseline. Benchmark results position the instance in the top 10% for large language model inference throughput across 7B and 70B parameter models, as well as single-core execution and image processing. This hardware profile provides high resource density for generative AI serving, data science workloads, rendering pipelines, and low-latency visualization tasks.
